title: Mailmerge scheduled individual email import
description: A single standalone email or a list of independently scheduled emails for the Mailmerge Individual emails importer.
$comment: Generate strict JSON, not JSONLines or Markdown. The root may be one email object or an array of email objects. Literal line breaks are invalid inside JSON strings; encode body line breaks as \n or use HTML with body_mode set to html.
x-ai-instructions: Create one entry for each external recipient and intended follow-up time.
Copy email addresses from authoritative external data; do not invent or guess an address.
Write a complete, recipient-ready subject and body. Do not leave template placeholders such as {{ name }}.
scheduled_at must be in the future. When no timezone is supplied, use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM and Mailmerge will interpret it in the operator browser's local timezone.
Omit profile_id when the operator should apply one profile from the Default sender profile dropdown. Preserve profile_id when the external workflow provides a known Mailmerge profile UUID.
Use body_mode markdown for plain text or Markdown. Use body_mode html only when body contains intentional HTML markup.
Do not add source-system fields, notes, phone numbers, or other properties to the output.

email.description: Recipient email address copied from the external source.

subject.description: Final rendered subject line for this recipient. It must not contain newline characters or unresolved template placeholders.

body.description: Final recipient-ready message body. In serialized JSON, paragraph breaks must be escaped as \n. Do not include unresolved template placeholders.

scheduled_at.description: Future send date and time. Prefer YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM without an offset when the operator's browser-local timezone should be used. Z or an explicit UTC offset may be supplied when the source time is timezone-aware.

profile_id.description: Optional Mailmerge sender-profile UUID. Omit this property to let the operator apply the selected Default sender profile to this entry.

body_mode.description: Optional rendering mode. Omit it for Markdown; specify html only for an HTML body.

examples.subject: Oppfolging pa min tidligere e-post
examples.body:
Hei,

Jeg folger opp e-posten jeg sendte tidligere.

Vennlig hilsen
Haris
